chunks: From him, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said the Takbir five times.

key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: How many Takbirs did the Prophet say in the funeral prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Sahih al-Tahdhib confirms the Sunnah of reciting five Takbirs in the funeral prayer, a practice widely accepted by Shia jurists as the normative method. It highlights the continuity of ritual form from the Prophet to the Imams, reinforcing the structural simplicity and spiritual focus of Salat al-Mayyit.
